card.title: Google Business Profile
card.subtitle: Nexotec sends the opening hours, closed days, address, phone and website of each connected location to its Business Profile at Google. Changes made at Google are not taken over: the nightly comparison shows them here.
card.notConfigured: Nexotec has not set up Google Business Profile yet. Once it has, you connect your locations here.
card.noLocations: Your business has no active location yet.
card.loadError: The Google Business Profile connections could not be loaded.

drift.never: Not checked yet – the comparison runs every night.
drift.failed: Google could not be read (checked on {{date}})
drift.skipped: Not checked: the location is deactivated.
drift.hint: Google shows something other than Nexotec here. Correct it at Google, or change the location in Nexotec – Nexotec then sends it again.

card.unmappedHint: Google offers no hours of their own for this department in this location's category. Its hours are not shown at Google.
card.pendingText: Choose the Google location that belongs to this location.
card.errorText: Google no longer grants access to this location. Disconnect it and connect it again.

pick.title: Choose Google location
pick.label: Google location
pick.empty: This Google sign-in manages no location.

disconnect.title: Disconnect the location from Google?
disconnect.body: Nexotec then sends nothing more to this Business Profile. The profile at Google stays as it is.

callback.failedTitle: The connection with Google did not go through
callback.expired: This sign-in has expired or was already used. Please start again.

photos.none: No images yet – you upload them under Publishing.
photos.stopped: The upload has stopped. The status page names the reason; the next change to the location starts it again.
photos.refusedHint: Google does not accept a refused image because of its size or format. Replace it under Publishing.
